headline: exSat Staking BTC protocol operates on Bitcoin native layer; consensus contracts + EVM bridge identified via audits; on-chain discovery blocked by Bitcoin-only chain restriction

findings.text: Protocol operates on Bitcoin mainchain (per pinned context); canonical block explorers (Etherscan, Basescan, etc.) do not support Bitcoin UTXO discovery; defipunkd API supports Ethereum/EVM chains only, not UTXO chains

Official docs at docs.exsat.network list EVM layer token contracts: XBTC 0xADeb1300E4860089d93233ddED31B33206ba8432, XSAT 0x8266f2fbc720012e5Ac038aD3dbb29d2d613c459 (appears to be exSat EVM layer, not native Bitcoin layer)

Two BlockSec audits fetched: consensus contracts audit (2024-10-19) and EVM/bridge audit (2024-09-29); audits document C++ consensus contracts (blksync, poolreg, staking, utxomng, etc.) and Solidity EVM bridge contracts
GitHub organization https://github.com/exsat-network identified with 41+ repositories; key repos include contract-of-consensus, evm-contract, evm-bridge-contracts, evmutil-contracts, exsat-client
Protocol's primary chain is Bitcoin; no EVM or traditional smart contract address enumeration possible on Bitcoin mainchain via standard explorers
Protocol does not follow traditional factory pattern for child contract discovery; native layer uses EOSIO-based consensus contracts, not EVM factory contracts
No on-chain addresses could be verified via blockchain explorers; all addresses from off-chain documentation only

rationale.verdict: exSat Staking BTC is a Bitcoin staking protocol with hybrid consensus (PoW+PoS) that operates on Bitcoin's native layer. Primary deployment is C++ consensus contracts on exSat's native layer (EOSIO-based). An EVM layer provides Solidity contracts for token bridging (XBTC wrapper, esBTC). Because the protocol is Bitcoin-native and not deployed on EVM chains, direct on-chain verification via standard block explorers (Etherscan, Basescan, etc.) is not feasible. Discovery is limited to off-chain sources: audits, documentation, and GitHub repositories. No Bitcoin UTXO addresses or native layer contract identifiers could be recovered from accessible sources during this run.

evidence.shows: BlockSec consensus contracts audit (October 2024) documenting in-scope C++ contracts: blkendt.xsat (Block Consensus), blksync.xsat (Block Synchronization), btc.xsat (BTC Token), custody.xsat (Custody), endrmng.xsat (Validator Management), exsat.xsat (XSAT Token), poolreg.xsat (Pool Registration), rescmng.xsat (Resource Management), rwddist.xsat (Reward Distribution), staking.xsat (Staking), utxomng.xsat (UTXO Management), xsatstk.xsat (XSAT Staking)

BlockSec EVM and Spring-EVM Bridge audit (September 2024) covering exSat EVM contract, exSat EVM Node, and exSat Spring-EVM Bridge with erc20 native contract and ERC20 Solidity wrapper for bridged tokens

Official documentation listing EVM layer token addresses: XBTC 0xADeb1300E4860089d93233ddED31B33206ba8432, XSAT 0x8266f2fbc720012e5Ac038aD3dbb29d2d613c459; references native and EVM layers; mainnet launched October 23, 2024

exSat GitHub organization with 41+ repositories including: contract-of-consensus, evm-contract, evm-bridge-contracts, evm-node, exsat-client, evmutil-contracts, system-contracts; confirms multi-layer architecture with native and EVM components
Native staking contract documentation referencing staking.xsat, btc.xsat (BTC token contract), and resource management; demonstrates native layer smart contract operations via cleos CLI
esBTC staking product announcement (November 2024) describing XBTC wrapping (1:1 with native BTC), bridge functionality, and XSAT token rewards; staking process flow documented

unknowns: D1-offchain: Bitcoin mainchain block explorers (blockchain.com, blockchair) do not expose named smart contracts like traditional EVM explorers; no tool available to perform Bitcoin-layer name-tag search equivalent to Etherscan searchHandler

D2-offchain: No canonical deployed-contracts documentation page found linking native-layer C++ contract addresses; consensus contracts referenced by name in audits but no on-chain verification possible

D4-offchain: GitHub repositories contain source code and deployment scripts but do not explicitly list final deployed contract addresses or accounts on native layer; Foundry/Hardhat artifacts not present in repos (build outputs may be in CI/CD or private deployment tools)

D5-offchain: Bitcoin does not support contract deployment in traditional sense; exSat's native layer runs on EOSIO protocol (not Bitcoin mainchain) with separate account/contract model incompatible with Bitcoin UTXO discovery
D6-offchain: No factory contracts discovered or documented; staking is monolithic, not pooled via factory pattern

D8-offchain: XBTC and XSAT addresses from documentation are EVM-layer wrapped tokens on exSat's EVM sidechain, not native Bitcoin addresses; custody/bridge architecture not fully resolved from available sources

protocol_metadata.about: exSat is a Bitcoin staking and data consensus layer that combines Proof of Work and Proof of Stake to import Bitcoin block data and enable smart contract functionality. Users stake BTC through wrapped XBTC tokens to earn XSAT rewards, while synchronizers (miners) and validators maintain consensus. The protocol features a native C++ smart contract layer for consensus operations and an EVM layer for DApp development.
